source.note: FLY и Ward сверены с Core Rules AoS 4 (Wahapedia, 15.4 и 18.1)

weaponAbilities.name: Anti-X (+1 Rend)
weaponAbilities.text: Add 1 to this weapon's Rend characteristic if the target has the keyword after 'Anti-' or fulfils the condition after 'Anti-'. Multiples of this ability are cumulative. For example, if a weapon has both Anti-charge (+1 Rend) and Anti-HERO (+1 Rend), then add 2 to the Rend characteristic of the weapon for attacks that target a HERO that charged in the same turn.

weaponAbilities.name: Charge (+1 Damage)
weaponAbilities.text: Add 1 to this weapon's Damage characteristic if the attacking unit charged this turn

weaponAbilities.name: Companion
weaponAbilities.text: Unless otherwise specified, attacks made by this weapon are not affected by friendly abilities that modify hit rolls, wound rolls or weapon characteristics, except for those that apply negative modifiers (e.g. 'Covering Fire')

weaponAbilities.name: Crit (2 Hits)
weaponAbilities.text: If an attack made with this weapon scores a critical hit, that attack scores 2 hits on the target instead of 1. Make a wound roll for each hit.

weaponAbilities.name: Crit (Auto-wound)
weaponAbilities.text: If an attack made with this weapon scores a critical hit, that attack automatically wounds the target. Make a save roll as normal.

weaponAbilities.name: Crit (Mortal)
weaponAbilities.text: If an attack made with this weapon scores a critical hit, that attack inflicts mortal damage on the target unit equal to the Damage characteristic of that weapon and the attack sequence ends.

weaponAbilities.name: Shoot in Combat
weaponAbilities.text: This weapon can be used to make shooting attacks even if the attacking unit is in combat.

keywords.name: Fly
keywords.text: As this unit moves, it ignores other models, terrain features and the combat ranges of enemy units. It cannot end its move in combat unless specified in the ability that allowed it to move. Ignore any vertical distance moved for this unit.

keywords.name: Ward Save
keywords.text: In step 1 of the damage sequence (see 18.0), make a ward roll of D6 for each damage point in this unit's damage pool. If the roll equals or exceeds this unit's ward value, remove that damage point from the damage pool.

keywords.name: Champion
keywords.text: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by champions in this unit.

keywords.name: Musician
keywords.text: While this unit contains any musicians, if it uses the 'Rally' command, you can make one additional rally roll of D6.

keywords.name: Standard Bearer
keywords.text: While this unit contains any standard bearers, add 1 to this unit's control score.

keywords.name: Beast
keywords.text: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.
